reason: Valve Juxtapose creates illusions on attack and allows illusions to create further illusions; Illusory Armaments strengthens those illusions. This is a core repeated mechanic, not a single utility illusion.
Valve Echo Slam says each enemy hit causes another echo that damages nearby units. A larger illusion group increases echoes, making this an explicit multi-unit interaction beyond generic AoE damage.
Valve Counter Helix is repeated pure damage to all nearby enemies after attacks against Axe; illusion groups provide many attack triggers and are all hit.
Valve Cold Embrace targets an ally, heals them, and blocks all physical damage during the cocoon.
Valve Mirror Image creates multiple controlled images, and Rip Tide explicitly lets Naga Siren's illusions apply bonus damage and armor reduction.
Valve Phantasm summons several illusions; Reality Rift transports his illusions and Chaos Strike grants their attacks critical strike and lifesteal.
Valve Conjure Image creates illusions; Metamorphosis, Demon Zeal, and Dark Unity explicitly modify nearby Terrorblade illusions.
Valve Nether Swap can reposition an allied hero and grants allied swapped units a protective barrier.
